# 💡 C93 · Content-Addressed Liveness Leak
**concept** · swordsman · knowledge

OPH V7 intake: Retained-record provenance is not an independently observed GUID-liveness leak. Status unchanged. A live content-address is an existence claim about its content; deduplication/GUID liveness leaks existence, and existence bounds the search. The address does not leak content; its liveness leaks existence. Active (55% · Run 8).
